prompt: A wide full-bleed painted landscape background for a game screen, filling the entire frame edge to edge. No characters, no people, no animals, no text, no watermark, no border, no frame, no UI. Farmland in high summer in the late afternoon: a broad field of green-gold barley, a terraced vineyard on the slope to one side with vines on low frames, scattered olive trees, a low stone field wall, distant blue hills, a warm hazy sky with long soft light. A clear walkable path or road runs from the bottom edge of the frame into the distance, centred, with open ground either side — the bottom third must be the walkable foreground, since small character figures are drawn standing on it. Flat stylised storybook painting, clean shapes, soft shading, no photorealism, no line art. Rich but not busy: it sits behind figures and must never compete with them.

THE ENTIRE BACKGROUND MUST BE SOLID PURE MAGENTA, RGB(255,0,255), edge to edge, filling every pixel that is not the figure itself — a flat chroma-key backdrop, NOT white, NOT grey, NOT a coloured wash, NOT a gradient, NOT a vignette, NOT a scene, NOT a border or frame. No ground, no shadow, no horizon, no text, no watermark, no second copy of the figure, no silhouette.

EXACTLY ONE FIGURE, SHOWN FROM THE FRONT IN A SINGLE VIEW. This is NOT a character turnaround, NOT a model sheet, NOT a reference sheet, NOT multiple poses or camera angles side by side, and NOT the same person drawn twice. One person, one pose, one view, alone in the frame.

A FULL-LENGTH STANDING FIGURE, SHOWN HEAD TO FEET, WITH BOTH FEET VISIBLE AND RESTING AT THE BOTTOM EDGE OF THE FRAME. This is NOT a portrait, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders crop, and NOT cropped at the waist, hips or knees — the whole body from the top of the head to the soles of the feet must be inside the frame, standing upright and facing the viewer. Arms at the sides or holding the named object, feet apart and flat.

A sower going out to sow, a man in a sun-bleached oatmeal tunic to the knee with the hem tucked up at one side, a broad seed bag slung across his body at the hip, one hand dipped into the bag and the other open and lowered as if scattering, bare forearms, dusty sandals. Mid-stride but standing square, calm and practised.
